panels.title: Switches reachable (of 8)
panels.description: Switches answering SNMP right now. Below 8 means a switch has no SNMP config, is down, or is unreachable.

panels.title: Fabric ports up
panels.description: swp ports with oper status up, all selected switches.

panels.title: Ports down (admin up)
panels.description: Ports configured up whose link is down. Unused ports (admin down) are not counted.

panels.title: Port traffic in
panels.description: Sum of ingress on all swp ports. Each fabric link is counted at both ends.

panels.title: Port traffic out
panels.description: Sum of egress on all swp ports.

panels.title: Errors + discards
panels.description: Errors and discards per second, all swp ports.

panels.title: Ingress by switch
panels.description: Bits/s received on swp ports, summed per switch.

panels.title: Egress by switch
panels.description: Bits/s sent on swp ports, summed per switch.

panels.title: Top 10 interfaces (in + out)
panels.description: Busiest swp ports over the selected range.

panels.title: Errors + discards by switch
panels.description: Should be flat at zero.

panels.title: SVI traffic - VLAN 10 / 20 / 30 (in + out)
panels.description: Routed (L3) traffic through the anycast-gateway SVIs, summed over the selected leafs.

panels.title: VXLAN traffic - vxlan48 (L2 VNIs) / vxlan99 (L3 VNI 10100)
panels.description: Tunnel-interface traffic: vxlan48 carries the L2 VNIs (10010/10020/10030), vxlan99 the L3 VNI.

panels.title: Memory used %
panels.description: Excludes memory available to applications.

panels.title: swp port state
panels.description: Operational state of every swp port. DOWN on a cabled port is a fault; DOWN on a spare port is normal.

panels.title: Sessions established
panels.description: BGP sessions in state Established, all selected switches (underlay eBGP unnumbered + any VRF-lite to the PEs).

panels.title: Sessions NOT established
panels.description: Configured sessions in any other state (idle, connect, active, opensent...).

panels.title: Session resets (1h)
panels.description: Established sessions that dropped in the last hour (flaps).

panels.title: EVPN routes received by switch
panels.description: l2vpn-evpn prefixes received from all peers of each switch. A sudden drop means a VTEP or a peering was lost.

panels.title: BGP peers
panels.description: One row per BGP session. State comes from the NVUE API; prefixes are received counts.

panels.title: Session state over time (UP / DOWN)
panels.description: One lane per session. Red = not established. Lane label: switch -> peer.

targets.expr: max by (target, peer, vrf) (bgp_peer_info{target=~"$switch",state="established"}) or (max by (target, peer, vrf) (bgp_peer_info{target=~"$switch",state!="established"}) * 0)
